scope: Renderer and construction controls executed by the common protected fault runner.

previousFailure.fact: Two fault controls passed a prediction object to the constructor worker. Its unsupported frame failed before any injection. The existing artifact did not identify the attempted fault or dispatched input.

required: Write the ordered plan before opening a worker. It records every fault name, source, independent semantic input, exact executable request and expected failure signal.
A normal receipt records the digest of that plan and the actual executable request used in both the healthy and altered executions.
An unsuccessful trial retains the exact last phase, fault name, chosen request, error type and reported signal. It remains an unsuccessful run.
Independent replay reconstructs the plan from the protected fault definitions and checks every normal receipt against its plan and the existing source, overlay and comparison witnesses.
controls: Reconstruct and verify a healthy execution and its expected injected failure.
Fail an executable request before injection and recover the original incorrect request, phase and planned fault set.
Reject a missing plan, a changed executable request or a receipt with a mismatched plan digest.
preserves: All preexisting native and SQLite comparison observations, expected detections, source integrity, execution budgets and mandatory F01–F12 controls.
trust: The fixed outer runner and worker transport. Published candidate PHP runs with the existing isolation rules and has no access to write the dispatch record.
